newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends sharply lower on commercial hedging.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends sharply lower on commercial hedging.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended sharply lower on Wednesday, pressured by commercial hedge sales, traders said.
"We had some small, cash-related hedge execution hitting the market," a floor source said.
Traders noted world market prices slipped last week amid poor world demand. Long grain whole kernels were listed at 11.15 cents per lb, versus 11.36 cents a week earlier, USDA reported on Tuesday.
The market awaited direction from Thursday's USDA weekly export sales report due at 0730 CST.
Traders expected roughly 20,000 tonnes of rice to be sold for export.
Rice ended 16-1/2 to one cent lower with May down 16-1/2 at $11.43-1/2.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 350 lots, compared with Tuesday's actual volume of 256 lots.
